purpose: Complementary pooled descriptive JcvPCA and repetition-design / sensitivity evidence. Separate from matched single-rep vs NV evidence in file 03.

critical_footing_rule.A_pooled_descriptive: T1(R1+R2) vs T{k}(R1+R2) on pooled ex09–ex13 block (file 06).
critical_footing_rule.B_matched_single_rep_vs_NV: T1_R1→T{k}_R1 compared with T1_R1→T1_R2 (+ reference-swap direction stability). Primary A2 evidence in file 03.
critical_footing_rule.C_repetition_sensitivity: Whether the pattern depends strongly on pooled vs R1-only vs R2-only (file 06).
critical_footing_rule.forbidden: Do NOT create pooled_longitudinal_change / single_rep_NV ratios. Do NOT treat pooled and matched-single-rep footings as numerically interchangeable.

top_k_definition_global: Unless noted, overlap metrics use top-5 links; pass heuristic >= 0.60 (>=3/5) per ROBUSTNESS_FRAMEWORK.md
